subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ + IRP excerpts for upcoming SOC 2 audit
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@greenline-payments.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: soc2-audit@greenline-payments.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Upcoming SOC 2 — request for IRP excerpts, SIG/CAIQ responses and postmortem template

Hi Neha,

Greenline's external audit window for SOC 2 Type II is scheduled the week of Jan 18. Our auditor asked us to collect three items from vendors: 1) a short excerpt of your Incident Response Plan showing escalation and notification processes, 2) completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ highlights for controls relevant to logging/monitoring/incident handling, and 3) a redacted postmortem template you use for security incidents.

Can you send those artifacts, or tell me when your security team can share them? We prefer PDFs or an XLSX for SIG answers. If there are any NDAs or redaction rules we should follow, let us know. We need vendor materials by Jan 6 to stay on audit schedule.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Greenline Payments
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: auditor_checklist_122026.pdf (reference only)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up.

Looping in Marissa and Karthik from Security — they'll own producing redacted IRP excerpts and our SIG/CAIQ pack. We should be able to deliver a redaction-ready IRP excerpt and a CAIQ-highlighted PDF by Jan 4; full SIG answers (XLSX) by Jan 6.

Marissa/Karthik — can you confirm scope (redaction level: full usernames/UUIDs removed) and whether the postmortem template below is acceptable for Greenline?

Neha

Hi Olivia — welcome, and thanks for the timeline. We can support the auditor requests. Quick notes: 

- For IRP excerpts we will produce a 1-2 page PDF that highlights notification timelines, roles (L1/L2/Security Lead), and external disclosure decision points. We will redact internal user identifiers and any customer-specific telemetry examples.
- For SIG/CAIQ, we maintain a living XLSX with mapped evidence. We'll export the control set and flag any control assertions that need auditor follow-ups.
- Postmortem template: we use a standardized template that includes evidence checklists and a redaction section — I'll attach a copy for your (and Neha's) review.

I'm attaching: redwood_irp_v3.2_redacted.pdf (IRP excerpt), redwood_sig_partial_answers.xlsx (current SIG export), postmortem-template-redwood.docx (template).

If the auditor needs raw logs or access to a SOC report, direct them to our legal/compliance contact (we can provide an MSA addendum). Also suggest a short call next week to walk the auditor through the highlighted CAIQ items.

Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_irp_v3.2_redacted.pdf, redwood_sig_partial_answers.xlsx, postmortem-template-redwood.docx

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Postmortem & redaction guidance + deliverable plan

Hi Olivia — attaching the finalized artifacts per our commit: 

Deliverables (per Greenline timeline):
- IRP excerpt (PDF): redwood_irp_v3.2_redacted.pdf — includes notification chain, timelines, disclosure decision tree.
- CAIQ highlights (PDF): caiq-highlighted-responses.pdf — we mark the auditor-relevant fields and include short evidence notes.
- SIG answers (XLSX): redwood_sig_partial_answers.xlsx — populated for controls in scope; cells with PII have been removed.
- Postmortem template (DOCX): postmortem-template-redwood.docx — we've included a redaction checklist at the top so auditors see how we sanitize examples.

A couple of important points for the auditor: 
- Redaction: all usernames, customer IDs, and raw IP addresses have been redacted. Timestamp ranges remain but are coarse (hour-level).
- Evidence extracts: for rotation/ops evidence we're providing hashes and ticket IDs, not full credentials or secret files.
- Legal/POC: for anything beyond the artifacts above (e.g., full SOC report, HSM logs) the auditor should request it through Greenline's legal procurement channel; we'll respond to requests under the MSA scope.

I'll upload the artifacts to the Drive link and send a share with viewer access to the auditor address. Neha — please let me know if you want anything added to the customer-facing note. Jonas — flagging in case you want to review the notification wording.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: caiq-highlighted-responses.pdf (uploaded), redwood_irp_v3.2_redacted.pdf (attached), redwood_sig_partial_answers.xlsx (attached), postmortem-template-redwood.docx (attached)

We'd like a short 20-minute call on Tue the 15th at 10:00 PT for the walkthrough — can you confirm calendar invite?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Olivia
